title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
TL;DR

We're hiring a Strategic Account Executive to personally source and close Lovable's largest, most complex deals - seven-and-eight-figure relationships with the Fortune 500 companies reimagining how software gets built. You'll own accounts end-to-end, from first executive conversation to signed contract, and help define how Lovable wins at the top of the market as a founding member of the strategic accounts team.

Why Lovable?

Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we're just getting started.

We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

What We're Looking For

- 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales, with a track record closing deals at $500K-$1M+ ACV, including multiple deals of $1M or more

- Consistent overachievement against $2-4M+ individual quotas in a comparable high-growth SaaS, developer platform, or AI-adjacent environment

- Demonstrated ability to personally source and close exec-sponsored deals in cold or strategic accounts - not just grow warm, existing relationships

- Experience navigating multi-threaded buying committees at Fortune 500 organizations, spanning security, procurement, legal, and executive leadership

- Comfort running long, complex sales cycles (6+ months) with high deal complexity and scrutiny

- Genuine fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day workflow

- Strong communicator who can translate technical and product concepts into clear business value for both technical and executive buyers

- Builder mindset who is energized by shaping a strategic accounts playbook and GTM motion that doesn't fully exist yet

- Curiosity and hunger to master Lovable's product deeply; you lead with insight

- Preferred: Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or AI platforms to technical buyers (CTOs, VPs Eng, CPOs) alongside security, procurement, and executive stakeholders

What You'll Do

- Personally source and close exec-sponsored, seven-figure+ deals in cold or strategic accounts, from first touch to signed contract

- Build strategic account plans that map multi-threaded buying committees - security, procurement, legal, economic buyer - to identify whitespace and unlock expansion

- Lead executive-level discovery and demos, tailoring value to both technical and executive buyers

- Build ROI-driven business cases that connect Lovable's capabilities to real outcomes for the largest, most strategic accounts

- Cultivate relationships with C-suite and senior technical stakeholders (CTOs, VPs Eng, CPOs) at Fortune 500 companies

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver seamless onboarding and expansion

- Maintain pipeline accuracy and forecasting discipline across all strategic deals

- Partner with the Sales Leadership to shape the strategic accounts playbook - your patterns become the company's patterns

- Build Lovable's presence in key markets through executive relationships, events, and partner co-selling

Projects You'll Tackle First

- Build and execute account plans for your first 5-10 strategic target accounts

- Run 5+ executive discovery sessions in your first 30 days to calibrate Lovable's positioning with the largest accounts in the market

- Partner with the Sales Manager to help design the account planning framework and executive engagement strategy

title: Staff Product Manager, Growth
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're looking for an experienced PM to lead a growth squad at LiveKit. Bottoms-up growth has always been in our DNA: build a product developers love, keep it open-source, include a generous free tier, and let word of mouth do the work. It has taken us a long way: many of our largest customer today started as a single developer building something new. As our business scales, and our GTM team grows for Enterprise sales, we now need a full-time squad focused on Product-Led Growth (PLG).

This squad will grow and maintain a large, diverse, healthy population of developers actively building on LiveKit. Some will break out into serious scale and become our future largest customers. We cannot pick which ones in advance, so the job is not to run a conventional acquisition funnel. It is to cultivate the population and make sure we notice and support what it produces. In practice that means more developers arriving, more of them getting to something real, more of them adopting the full platform, and the ones who take off having us alongside them the whole way.

Our PM team is small and high-leverage, with each PM coming in to establish the foundations in a new area of the business. You'd run the growth squad (product, design, engineering, marketing, and analytics), work alongside our developer support engineers on the accounts that are scaling, and partner with marketing on everything upstream of signup.

This role can be based remotely or in our SF HQ, where you'll be part of a collaborative in-office culture!

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU:

- are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

- are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

- work hard and can build and ship fast

- are focused on polish, detail, and quality

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is by trying LiveKit's product, understanding the space, and bringing smart thoughts and opinions to the table.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own Product-Led Growth end to end. From how a developer first hears about us through onboarding, adoption, and growth into a production workload. Where the path crosses into marketing or into another product team, you're the person accountable for the whole thing working rather than for a slice of it.

- Grow the population. More developers arriving, from more places, building more kinds of things. Own the surfaces that decide whether someone who lands on LiveKit ends up building on it, including how we show up to the AI tools developers now use to choose their stack.

- Get developers to a real workload, not just a first run. Own onboarding and activation as product surfaces. The distance between "signed up" and "actually built something" is still large, and closing this gap is one of our biggest growth levers.

- Stay close to the builders who are taking off. Keep tabs on the accounts finding traction, identify them early, understand what they're building, and make sure we're helping them scale rather than finding out after the fact.

- Drive platform depth. Developers who adopt more of LiveKit build more with us and stay longer. Work with the product teams to make attaching products like agent hosting, LiveKit Inference, and Agent Observability the natural path early on, rather than a later upsell.

- Be the voice of the self-serve developer. Tens of thousands of people a month touch our product without ever talking to anyone here. Bring what they experience back into the roadmap, from the docs through to the product itself.

•
Safety Oversight:  Evaluate potential risks, review ongoing safety of trial participants, and assess adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs) for causality, severity, and collaborates as needed with PV teams.

•
Protocol & Study Design:  Provide medical expertise for protocol development, study design, and clinical study reports; align study objectives with best practices and patient safety priorities.

•
Data Review:  Analyze clinical data, lab results for screened and enrolled participants, and electronic data to detect early warning signs of safety issues or protocol deviations. Provides medical coding supervision.

•
Regulatory Compliance:  Ensure adherence to ICH-GCP, FDA/EMA guidelines, and institutional policies; participate in data safety monitoring boards and meetings as needed.

•
Investigator and CRO Liaison:  Serve as the additional point of contact for clinical investigators, and CRO medical monitors responding to protocol-related queries, and safety reporting.

•
Decision-Making:  Discusses at weekly medical monitors meetings or other study meetings data that pertains to the safety measures based on trial data.

•
Reporting: reports into Clinical Development line function and presents during weekly MM meetings and discusses unclear or complex clinical trial data and potential deviations.

•
Collaboration:  Coordinate work with other team members in Clinical Development and Clinical Operations, CRAs to address potential protocol deviations, improve recruitment, and reduce noncompliance risks. Participates in the monthly medical and safety meetings within ProKidney and with the CRO.

•
Workload: approximately 20 hours spread over week (about 4 hours daily).
Skills & Qualifications

•
Medical Education and Expertise: MD, licensed and board-eligible or preferably board-certified internist with a strong clinical background in the trial’s therapeutic area, or nephrologist with experience in cell therapy. Phase 3 industry trial medical monitoring experience required.

•
Regulatory Knowledge:  Familiarity with GCP, FDA/EMA guidelines, and trial ethics.

•
Analytical Skills:  Ability to interpret complex clinical data and identify trends.

•
Communication:  Clear, professional communication with investigators, sponsors’ team members, and CRO medical teams.

•
Documentation and use of electronic clinical study data:  Meticulous record-keeping to support audits and inspections. Experience with MEDIDATA and/or other EDC systems used in clinical trials.

title: Loss Control Consultant (Workers Comp)
description:
About Integrated Specialty Coverages

Integrated Specialty Coverages, LLC (ISC) is a growth stage technology and data-driven commercial MGA and insurance wholesaler leading innovation in the market.

Backed by one of the leading private equity firms, Onex Partners, and led by a forward-thinking management team, ISC is combining the worlds of insurance and technology to create an Insurtech powerhouse. As a leading online distributor of insurance products for a range of industries and “Main Street USA”, we are looking for the right people to help us in our mission of achieving exponential growth. We strive to be the number one place to go for brokers and agents to source insurance. To accomplish this, we’re building a digitally focused team that deeply understands the intersection between user experience, data, and AI/ML to optimize the way we engage with our customers and partners.

Job Summary:
ISC just launched its Workers’ Compensation platform with BusinessFirst Insurance, a new brand that builds on the longstanding strength of RetailFirst Insurance Group, with over 13,000 policies, service in 8 states with $180M+ Written Premium.
The Workers' Compensation Loss Control Representative provides consultative risk management and occupational safety services to current and prospective policyholders. This role partners with employers to identify workplace hazards, evaluate safety programs, and recommend practical solutions that reduce employee injuries, improve regulatory compliance, and minimize workers' compensation claim frequency and severity. The representative conducts on-site safety evaluations, assists employers in developing effective injury prevention strategies, analyzes loss trends, and collaborates with Underwriting and Claims to support sound risk selection, pricing, and claim reduction initiatives. Success in this role requires strong technical knowledge of occupational safety, effective relationship management, and the ability to communicate practical recommendations that improve workplace safety and operational performance. Travel throughout the assigned territory using various forms of transportation, including automobile and occasional air travel, is required.
Position Responsibilities:

• Manage an assigned book of workers' compensation policyholders within a designated territory.

• Conduct on-site loss control surveys, risk assessments, and follow-up visits to evaluate workplace hazards, employee exposures, and safety management practices. Identify operational risks that may contribute to workplace injuries and workers' compensation losses.

• Develop written reports that document findings, evaluate existing controls, and provide actionable recommendations to reduce occupational injuries.

• Review loss history and claim data to identify trends and prioritize risk improvement opportunities.

• Consult with employers to develop, implement, and improve injury and illness prevention programs, safety policies, and loss prevention initiatives.

• Provide guidance on OSHA regulations, industry best practices, and workers' compensation risk management strategies.

• Deliver safety training, toolbox talks, and educational presentations for policyholders and internal business partners as appropriate.

• Partner with Underwriting by providing technical assessments that support account selection, pricing, renewals, and risk improvement strategies.

• Collaborate with Claims and Underwriting personnel on large or complex losses to identify contributing factors and recommend corrective actions that reduce future claims.

• Maintain accurate inspection documentation, service plans, activity reports, and customer communications.

• Stay current on occupational safety regulations, industry trends, and emerging workplace hazards.

• Participate as needed in marketing/presentations to assigned agencies.

• Participate in departmental projects, continuous improvement initiatives, and other duties as assigned.

description:

The Data Platform team is responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and optimising our modern data platforms and infrastructure. Our main goal is to ensure the organisation has seamless access to high-quality, reliable, and performant data, from ingestion through to consumption by various teams. • Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub for automated testing, deployment, and version control.

• Collaborate with stakeholders across Engineering, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering to gather requirements and deliver high-impact data solutions.

• Ensure data quality, reliability, and observability across the platform through robust monitoring, alerting, and testing frameworks.

Our Values & Culture 🌞

• Just Pilot: We never settle for "good enough". We pilot new ideas fast, ask questions to figure it out, and scale quickly.

• Why Not Today? Fast is as slow as we go - speed and simplicity gives us a competitive advantage.

• Be a Buddy: We tap in from day one to help the team, we do the right thing even if it's hard.

• Owners and Dates: We don't chase people. If you own a task and agree to a date, the expectation is that it gets done.

• Feedback: We want our employees to flourish, so we regularly provide direct and constructive feedback.

We're Looking For 🔎

• Proven experience as a Data Engineer, designing, building, and maintaining scalable data platforms and pipelines.

• Deep experience with Snowflake, including advanced features like dynamic data masking, row-level security, data backups, and ELT tools.

• Strong Python skills for data engineering, scripting, and automation.

• Strong SQL performance, with a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts.

• Demonstrated experience with GitHub, CI/CD, and collaborative development.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable working with technical and non-technical colleagues.

• Experience in kubernetes, datadog and ML model deployments are great to have.

Interview Process 🤝

• First stage: 30 minute intro and values call with Talent Partner (Video call).

• Second stage: 60 minute CV overview with Head of Data Platform & Team Manager (Video call).

• Final stage: Split into two parts - Part 1: 60 minute technical assessment with 2 members of the Data Engineering team. Part 2: 30 minute chat with the rest of the team (Virtual).

Diversity & Inclusion 🌈

We welcome, consider and encourage applications

title: Partner Sales Executive - Intelligence Center X (ADT)
description:
Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise
 
The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code - it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities - an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance - that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.
For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.
This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market - built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications - with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry - this is where that work is happening.

In the A&D, A&T and Heavy Equipment sectors, ICX provides the governed foundation for AI agents to operate across the entire product lifecycle-from long-term defense program certification to the management of high-volume automotive fleets and heavy equipment rolling stock.
The Opportunity We are seeking a high-caliber Partner Sales Executive to lead our channel sales efforts unit within the Aerospace, Defense, Automotive, Transportation, and Heavy Equipment verticals. This is a role for a Strategic Architect who can navigate the friction of a complex ecosystem to drive enterprise-wide transformation.
This role owns the Enterprise Channel segment across North America, focused on high-growth organizations-typically less than $5B in revenue-that require the agility of the ICX platform to compete with industry titans, partner with them, or meet the demanding standards of the major OEMs, customers, and ecosystem leaders they serve.
You will be responsible for a high-stakes territory where many customers are already Siemens users (PLM, CAD, Simulation, MES), but have yet to realize the power of Industrial AI. Your mission is to bridge that gap-sometimes by up-leveling traditional engineering partners, and other times by boldly forging new paths with specialized Digital Transformation partners to reach the CIO, CDO, and COO.

Orchestrate Complex Ecosystems
Navigate the Room: Manage the delicate balance between established PLM/Engineering partners, specialized ICX partners, and internal Siemens account teams. title: Technical Escalations Engineer 2 (Web Platform) - US-West
locationText: Denver, Colorado, USA; San Francisco, California, USA
description:
As Datadog’s in-house product experts, the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team plays a critical role in driving our global success. We enable our customers, from the world’s most innovative startups to the largest enterprises.

Through deep technical expertise, relentless problem-solving, and exceptional customer engagement, we educate, guide, and troubleshoot, delivering high-impact solutions that shape the customer experience. Whether through hands-on technical call, in-depth fact findings meeting, or complex investigations, we set the gold standard for technical excellence and customer advocacy.

As part of our TEE team, you’ll tackle the most challenging technical problems, collaborate directly with Engineering and Product to refine and evolve our platform, and mentor teams worldwide, elevating the technical bar at every level.

As part of the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team, you’ll operate at the heart of Datadog’s ecosystem, working at the intersection of Technical Solutions, Engineering, Product, and our Customers. Every challenge you take on will directly impact the performance, scalability, and success of both our clients and our platform. You’ll be in an environment that moves fast, challenges you daily, and rewards curiosity, ownership, and technical excellence.

This is your chance to shape the future of observability and security, driving innovation, mentoring teams, and influencing product direction while witnessing your expertise make an immediate and lasting impact. 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 

What You’ll Do:

• Develop deep technical expertise and continuously learn as the product evolves.

• Investigate complex escalations, lead high-stakes technical calls, and drive solutions for our most critical customer challenges with urgency and precision.

• Run engaging office hours, deliver impactful learning sessions, and mentor the Global Support Engineering team (GSE), ensuring they’re equipped to handle any challenge.

• Partner with Engineering and Product to proactively identify gaps, drive improvements, and advocate for customers in shaping the evolution of our platform.

• Become the go-to expert for the Web Platform experience at Datadog, owning investigations across authentication, authorization, identity, enterprise administration, and the full visualization stack of our graphing features (e.g. dashboards, notebooks, sheets, DDSQL)

• Handle complex escalations related to login failures, broken dashboards, permission mismatches, audit discrepancies, and visualization bugs.

• Coordinate investigations that span several product areas at once, keeping every team involved working from the same picture and staying accountable for the outcome even when the fix belongs to someone else

• Develop internal tooling, debugging guides, and reusable workflows to help TSEs resolve access and UI issues efficiently and consistently.

 

Who You Are:

• A self-driven problem solver with an obsession for excellence and continuous learning. You thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and push beyond expectations.

• A strategic thinker who defaults to a client-centric approach, proactively identifying opportunities to enhance customer experience while balancing technical feasibility.

• An independent, fast learner, capable of picking up new technologies, adapting to evolving priorities, and crafting innovative solutions to complex technical issues.

• A collaborator and mentor, who enjoys sharing knowledge, raising the technical bar for the team, and contributing to a culture of excellence.

• Deeply familiar with authentication standards and patterns (SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, SCIM), and confident debugging access issues across identity providers and account configurations.

title: Remote Nutrition Specialist
description:
About Enara
Enara is a world renowned obesity and medical weight loss start-up, based in Silicon Valley, pioneering the use of data, digital, and clinical treatments to provide personalized plans with measurable results. Enara was founded by people from Stanford, UCSF, Kaiser, ClassPass & Evernote. Our mission is to develop the first ever platform to scale obesity treatment. Our platform allows for the latest breakthroughs in nutrition, exercise, and obesity science to be optimized and delivered in a series of personalized and programmable experiences. Our solutions are disseminated through unified products and services we deploy for the healthcare ecosystem; with a current focus on small to medium sized medical groups and clinics. Our platform has served over 2000 members and delivers world leading 16%+ weight loss sustained over 3 years. We deliver life changing care to members and we are redesigning the clinic-patient . We are backed by , , VSC, Continuum Ventures, as well as many prominent angels in Silicon Valley.
Role:
We are seeking an enthusiastic, communicative and organized Nutrition Specialist who is passionate about treating obesity as a disease to improve the myriad chronic health conditions associated with weight- including hypertension, type 2 diabetes, sleep apnea and more- to join our team. In this role, you will see patients via telehealth and work with a multidisciplinary team including medical providers and exercise physiologists to provide best-in-class care and outcomes for your patients - communicating with them both synchronously and asynchronously. This role is perfect for those who want a flexible working schedule and the ability to work from anywhere.
Minimum Requirements

• We are looking for health coaches with:

• at least a 4 year Nutrition and Dietetics degree, with at least 1 year experience coaching lifestyle and habit changes using nutrition and exercise. The Nutrition Specialist will work closely under a lead NS to provide evidence-based obesity science and nutrition advice.

• Must reside in the US or legally allowed to work in the United States (NPI required)
OR

We are looking for dietitians with:

• Bachelor's degree in Food &/or Nutritional Science.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in clinical nutrition as a Registered Dietitian , specifically working with patients with Diabetes or other metabolic diseases.

• Current registration w/ the Commission on Dietetic Registry (CDR) in good standing.

• Knowledge of clinical competencies based on Nutrition Care Standards of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics (AND).
For either type of applicant:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills required.

• Strong proficiency and experience with medical technology including EMR and mobile apps.

• Collaboration & problem solving skills required.

• Ability to manage a large patient load and multiple platforms both in face to face and app communication.

• Strong ability to empathize and connect with patients on a regular long term basis.

• Experience and comfortability working with our proprietary tech app.

• Past start up experience a plus but not required.

Bonus Qualifications

• Previous experience in curriculum development.

• Demonstrated knowledge of behavior change.

• Previous individual, small group and large group/classroom training/teaching experience.

• Fluency in Spanish or Arabic a strong bonus and will be compensated for.

Position Specifics

• Part time contractor ramping to full time salaried opportunity

• Employee and health benefits provided with 75% time or more

• Compensation variable on experience and credentials

• Remote position with ability to work in multiple time zones.

• Experience working with e-commerce, DTC, or subscription-based brands.

Benefits

title: Relationships Manager
locationText: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States
description:
Why Verifone

For more than 30 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located.

What's Exciting About the Role

As an Enterprise Account Manager, you will own and grow strategic relationships with enterprise-level clients. You’ll act as a trusted advisor, ensuring customer success through proactive engagement, problem-solving, and delivering value-driven solutions. This role requires a self-starter with deep knowledge of payment technologies and hardware solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Account Ownership: Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise clients, ensuring retention and expansion.

• Customer Engagement: Build strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders, acting as their primary point of contact.

• Solution Expertise: Leverage your knowledge of payment systems and hardware to provide tailored solutions that meet client needs.

• Problem Solving: Address complex challenges with creativity and urgency, ensuring customer satisfaction.

• Strategic Planning: Develop account plans, forecast revenue, and identify growth opportunities.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with technical teams, product managers, and support to deliver exceptional service.

• Market Insight: Stay informed on industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies.

Qualifications

• 5+ years in enterprise account management or related sales role.

• Proven experience in payments industry and hardware solutions.

• Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Self-starter with a proactive mindset.

• Customer-centric with a passion for delivering value.

Our Commitment

Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

title: Procurement Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Sourcing Specialist to join our Procurement team. In this role you will own sourcing and negotiation for purchases across multiple spend categories, guide requests end-to-end through our procurement process, and use spend data to shape where we go after savings next.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with a lot of internal visibility. You will work daily with stakeholders across Engineering, Marketing, Sales, IT, Legal, Security, and Finance. If you like building process and are energized by learning in a fast-moving vendor landscape you will do well here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Sourcing and negotiation

- Lead vendor negotiations for purchases across multiple spend categories - commercial terms, pricing, discounts, payment terms, ramps, and renewal protections.

- Run competitive sourcing events (RFI/RFP/RFQ) where appropriate, build and present bid comparisons, and make a clear recommendation.

- Prepare for negotiations with benchmarks, usage data, and a defined walk-away position; document outcomes and realized savings.

- Own the renewal calendar for your categories - engage stakeholders well ahead of renewal dates and eliminate surprise auto-renewals.

Process ownership and cross-functional execution

- Shepherd purchase requests through the full intake-to-pay process, coordinating with Legal on contract review and redlines, Security on vendor risk and data reviews, IT on provisioning and access, and Finance on budget, PO, and accrual treatment.

- Keep requests moving: chase the critical path, set expectations on timelines, and escalate early when something is stuck.

- Manage supplier onboarding - required documentation, tax forms, banking verification, and supplier records in our systems.

- Maintain clean, auditable records for every transaction: approvals, executed agreements, and negotiation history.

Analysis and recommendations

- Analyze purchasing and spend data to surface consolidation opportunities, duplicate or underused tools, pricing outliers, and category trends.

- Maintain reporting on savings, cost avoidance, cycle time, and spend under management; present findings to Procurement leadership and budget owners.

- Support annual and quarterly budget planning with category-level spend insight and forward-looking renewal forecasts.

Driving initiatives forward

- Improve the internal experience of buying at ClickHouse: clearer guidance, faster turnaround, less friction, better self-service.

- Act as a knowledgeable point of contact for the business on procurement policy, thresholds, and "how do I buy this?" questions.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 2+ years of sourcing, procurement, or strategic purchasing experience, including hands-on vendor negotiation.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.

- Strong finance fundamentals.

- A genuine customer-service orientation toward internal stakeholders - responsive, clear, and easy to work with, while still holding the line on process and policy.

- Self-driven and comfortable with ambiguity: you identify what needs doing, prioritize it, and follow through without being managed to it.

- Ability to adapt and learn quickly in an evolving function and a fast-moving industry - new categories, new vendor models, new tooling.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, and the credibility to negotiate with senior vendor counterparts.

SPECIAL CONSIDERATION FOR

- Experience sourcing in a high-growth technology or SaaS company.

- Familiarity with procurement and adjacent tooling - P2P platforms, CLM, ERP, and spend visibility tools.

- Working knowledge of contract terms and third-party risk concepts: DPAs and GDPR, SOC 2 and security review, insurance requirements, and AI/data-use terms.

- Experience supporting a global, multi-entity business - multi-currency purchasing, international suppliers, and regional tax or invoicing requirements.

- Contracts, rates, and earnings: How work converts into money owed, and how experts see it.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a systems-minded Operational Risk Manager to mature and scale our day-to-day risk and safety infrastructure. • Product Liaison: Translate day-to-day operational risk data, predictive analysis, and trends into nuanced requirements that secure roadmap prioritization from Product teams.

• Systems-Based Thinking: You analyze how our daily workflows interact, identifying bottlenecks or weak points in current frameworks to optimize the entire ecosystem.

You have:

• Experience: 5+ years of Operational experience, with a focus on managing or maturing risk/operational workflows.

• Safety Framework Knowledge: Practical working knowledge of Safety Management Systems (SMS) principles and their application in fast-paced, live operational environments.

• Process Improvement & Systems Thinking: Proven track record of evaluating complex workflows, identifying failure modes, and authoring clear, comprehensive operational documentation.

• Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust, align diverse stakeholders, and influence without formal authority.

We prefer:

• Prior experience in the Autonomous Vehicle (AV) industry.

• Operational risk or safety assurance experience within high-reliability and safety-critical industries (e.g., commercial aviation, defense, aerospace, rail/transit, energy, or complex fleet logistics).

• Experience with root-cause analysis methodologies (e.g., 5-Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa, FMEA) and developing predictive operational indicators.

The Content Associate Manager will build out Kenya’s content collection system and improve our in-country storytelling: empowering the people receiving cash transfers (recipients) to tell their own stories and enabling the content team to collect content that will drive awareness of the voices of people in poverty. They’ll also support the in-country office’s work representing our work and impact on external stakeholders through field visits and reports under the direct supervision of the Manager - External Relations.

Unique and transparent recipient story collection has been vital in driving awareness for GiveDirectly’s work, enabling us to raise and deliver more funds to people in poverty. Public efforts like GDLive, as well as our short film and social media posts, bring public attention to the specific lives of the people we seek to assist. Specific, unfiltered stories of the recipients donors reached encourage continued giving.

• Improve and codify content collection practices, setting and maintaining standards for the quantity and quality of stories collected by the Content team.

• Maintain a photo and video asset library, including metadata tagging and consent tracking.

• Support the Content Creation Manager in training in-country teams on GDLives and content collection practices.

• Collaborate with Partnerships, Growth and in-country management teams to build buy-in and deliver against cross-functional content priorities.

• Cultivate a roster of local filmmakers, photographers and artists for special projects and creative collaborations.

• Collaborate with recipients to enable them to tell their own stories through appropriate technology, tools and training.

• Shoot and edit high-quality short-form video, photography and digital stories for social media, donor communications, reports and external engagements.

• Produce reels, short documentaries, photo essays, interviews, event coverage and other multimedia formats.

• Develop creative concepts, storyboards and production plans for multimedia projects.

• Independently capture high-quality content during field visits and programme activities.

• Adapt and edit content for different platforms and audiences while maintaining GD’s brand and safeguarding standards.

title: Full Stack Developer - AI Integration (f/m/d)
description:
ABOUT US

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

ABOUT OUR TECHNOLOGY

The semiconductor industry's growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude. In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

THE ROLE

Black Net is our internal digital platform - the operational backbone that keeps the company running as we scale. It handles everything from time tracking and absence management to project reimbursements, procurement, and more. It is not a side project: it is how our employees get things done every day. Black Net is greenfield in the truest sense. The architecture decisions are modern, the codebase is clean, and the product is expanding into new territory every quarter.

As we grow rapidly toward our first pilot production in FabONE, the demands on our internal tooling are growing just as fast. We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with a genuine passion for AI-augmented development.

In this role, you will not just build features - you will also be the person who brings AI-powered development practices into the team. You will set up tools like Claude Code and similar AI coding assistants, integrate them into our workflow, and help your colleagues get the most out of them. Part builder, part enabler.

TO JOIN OUR TEAM, YOU SHOULD BE EXCITED TO:

- Design and implement full-stack features across our internal network (Angular, Node.js, MongoDB)

- Champion AI-augmented development within the team: set up, configure, and maintain tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar

- Collaborate closely with the Product Owner to translate requirements and user stories into working software

- Contribute to architecture decisions as Black Net expands its feature surface (ERP integration, procurement workflows, and beyond)

- Integrate AI coding agents and automation into Black Net's processes

- Participate in code reviews with an eye for quality, maintainability, and scalability

- Refine existing best practices and team agreements as the team grows

- Occasionally run knowledge-sharing sessions so that all team members can benefit from AI coding tools

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

Must have:

- At least 3 years of hands-on experience in full stack web development

- Proficiency in TypeScript and experience with a modern frontend framework - Angular is our stack, but strong React or Vue candidates will be considered

- Backend development experience with Node.js and REST API design

- Hands-on experience with a document or relational database (we use MongoDB)

- Active experience with at least one AI coding assistant (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codeium, or similar) - not just awareness, but genuine daily use

- Ability to explain AI tooling and development concepts clearly to colleagues with varying technical backgrounds

- A self-starter mindset: comfortable working in a small team where there is no large support structure, and where you will often define the way things get done
